mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-style-authoring.test.ts:paragraph style authoring executes24 saved outcomes and atomic refusals
outcomes: The wrapper reports no failures and 24 passed cases. Pinned bindings check one internal styles link, MIME and creation receipt, Custom definition name/type/flags/base, allowed graph changes, earlier definition fragments and unrelated payloads, then selection/text after byte reopen. Refusals preserve bytes, version and paragraph identity.
gaps: Two aggregate assertions only; semantic predicates are delegated. Definitions and selection use byte reopen with no path save. Existing definitions are checked as raw substrings, not position/occurrence counts or full registry equality. Custody precedes the separate selection step, which changes main XML; unchanged main bytes are not claimed after that selection. Errors only require a docx- prefix. No effective formatting or rendering claim.
Source mapping only; direct/deferred assertion separation and dynamic review flags are retained. Runtime leaves unknown; no new execution, inherited-formatting or rendering credit.
